Openings
slides.caption: Personal Banker is one of five titles behind 67.2% of branch hiring at Kotak and Axis. Then Elite Banker (1,180), Business Development Associate (688), Branch Relationship Officer (371) and Assistant Branch Manager (368).

slides.headline: Starting out? Nearly every entry-level branch opening is one title.
slides.sub: are Business Development Associate, and only Axis posts it. Each asks for a graduate degree and one year's experience.
slides.caption: Starting out? 688 of the 711 entry-level branch openings are Business Development Associate, and only Axis posts it. Each asks for a graduate degree, one year's experience, and sales and lead generation.

slides.headline: About half of Axis's entry-level openings are in Mumbai and NCR.
slides.note: Business Development Associate openings. NCR is Delhi, Gurugram and Noida.
slides.caption: About half of those are in Mumbai (169) and NCR (more than 170). Then Bengaluru 87, Kolkata 69 and Chennai 67.

slides.headline: Your city decides which bank is hiring you.
head: City
Who posts most
slides.note: Axis posts only in Mumbai, NCR, Bengaluru, Chennai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Pune and Ahmedabad.
slides.caption: Your city decides which bank is hiring you. Axis posts 76.4% of Kolkata's branch openings and 68.9% of Chennai's. Kotak posts 57.3% of Pune's, and every opening outside Axis's 10 cities.
